overdraw.title: Implausible consumption for {spool}
overdraw.description:
A print reported {requested} g for {spool}, which is {overdraw} g more than the roll had left. The roll was set to 0 g instead of going negative.

Weigh the roll and correct it with the measured gross weight, then this issue disappears.
